description: Runs the Android Automotive build of Google Maps (26.10.120003.E) on BYD DiLink 3 head units (Android 10) with MicroG-RE 7.3.0: sign-in, map, search, navigation and voice, UI density, driver side and color scheme settings, 3D buildings in the map layers, the car's battery for EV routing (on by default on the tested BYD Dolphin) and the battery to arrive with at charging stops and at the destination, Send to car from phone Maps with a car name you choose, an in-app problem report that is sent only after you review it, a daily check for a newer release, and a safe mode with feature switches. The app is named "Maps" unless you set another name in the App name option. BYD battery, Send to car, the BYD location flicker fix, BYD navigation volume and 3D buildings are separate patches. Requires Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer.
